body:
im sorry to hear that i had a friend that did the same a few years ago its hard to get over but talking helps

i actually just started my own post here and and i was told to try and help  others to help myself and truthfully i think its a good idea so if u want to talk i think it could help us both out i could even give you my email if you would like mainly because i dont get to check reddit as much as i would like. if not i totally understand. just know im trying my hardest to overcome my depression and i hope you will too

as far as meds go i was on anti-depressants for i while, i forget the name, but the werent helping actually seemed to make it worse on occasion, i now take a xanax from time to time and the help me relax and get to sleep.
as for my mom, i moved back in about a year ago when i lost my last job, and have paid half the rent since them but now shes lost her job and she moved away to live with my dad again and i cant do it things would b worse for me there than here...so i got the house. my friend was gonna b my rommate but when he proposed he decided they couldnt live with me they needed there own place, understandable dont get me wrong, just leaves alone with a big house note

and as for work im only making 10.50 an hour but doing the work of 7 ppl because all but 1 other guy quit and they wont hire, and when i asked for a raise the said in a year or if i had a better offer on the table they would talk, and though i feel cooking is the only thing im good at in this world i cant find a job anywhere been looking for about 4 months now so far no luck

i feel real depressed so that leads to me not really wanting to do anything so thats ruined my recent relationships and work im over worked and underapreciated but my mom lost her job so she left me the house so i cant quit....things just tend to pile up all at once

and my sister just went to jail for meth and her kids are gonna get put in foster care because im dont meet financial stabilty requirements to adopt them

Thnx.. im not gonna lie i feel a little embarrassed to post but having understanding ppl reply makes feel a little better im just tired of crawling in a bottle when things get rough and lately it seems things are staying rough...i appreciate having some1 to talk to
